digest: Mapped implementation architecture across 3 core source modules (workflow-stop, workflow-cancellation, workflow-terminal), config/package surfaces, 7 public entry points, 4 primary data flows, and identified 4 key environment/structural unknowns.

components.name: workflow-stop
components.role: Execution stop intent detection, foreground signal registration, periodic polling, and stop error construction.
internalState: launchSignals (module-scoped Map<string, Set<AbortSignal>> keyed by workflowRunPath(cwd, runId))

components.name: workflow-cancellation
components.role: Provider boundary cancellation classification and nested response content inspection.

components.name: workflow-terminal
components.role: Terminal workflow execution summary, dynamic controller status evaluation, and retry metrics aggregation.

components.name: package-and-build-config
components.role: Package metadata, execution module type, and typecheck script specification.

components.name: spec-definition
components.role: Ground-truth specification covering stop detection (S1-S7), cancellation classification (C1-C2), terminal summary (T1-T3), and test coverage (Q1).

entryPoints.name: bindWorkflowLaunchSignal
entryPoints.signature: (cwd: string, runId: string, signal: AbortSignal | undefined): () => void
entryPoints.purpose: Registers a foreground AbortSignal for the exact run execution path and returns an unbind cleanup function.

entryPoints.name: createWorkflowStopSignal
entryPoints.signature: (cwd: string, runId: string, options?: { pollMs?: number }): { signal: AbortSignal; dispose: () => void }
entryPoints.purpose: Spawns an AbortSignal monitored against foreground registrations and periodic disk stop-intent reads.

entryPoints.name: throwIfWorkflowStopRequested
entryPoints.purpose: Eagerly asserts that neither foreground nor durable stop intent has been flagged, propagating disk read errors directly.

entryPoints.name: isWorkflowStopRequestedError
entryPoints.callerRole: Error handler / catch block in workflow execution engine
entryPoints.purpose: Identifies whether an unhandled rejection / error corresponds to a user-initiated stop request.

entryPoints.name: isWorkflowReturnedCancellation
entryPoints.purpose: Classifies provider result payloads and nested JSON content strings as cancellations vs normal errors/completions.

entryPoints.name: summarizeWorkflowTerminal
entryPoints.callerRole: Workflow engine exit handler / CLI summary presenter
entryPoints.purpose: Computes semantic execution status, resolves dynamic controller status, and sums retry metrics across tasks.

dataFlows.name: Foreground Signal Abort Flow
dataFlows.path: AbortSignal registered in module-scoped launchSignals Map -> checked by launchStopRequested(cwd, runId) -> aborts controller with createWorkflowStopRequestedError(runId) or throws directly.

dataFlows.name: Durable Disk Stop Intent Flow
dataFlows.path: External stop command writes intent file -> polled via setInterval(check, pollMs) in createWorkflowStopSignal (disk errors caught and suppressed) or awaited in throwIfWorkflowStopRequested (disk errors propagated) -> triggers WorkflowStopRequested abort/error.

dataFlows.name: Provider Boundary Cancellation Inspection
dataFlows.path: Value inspected for DOMException AbortError -> value.cancelled flag -> value.details.cancelled flag -> error/reason candidate matching ('aborted', 'AbortError', 'ABORT_ERR', 'cancelled', 'timeout') -> value.content array iteration -> JSON.parse text -> recursive isWorkflowReturnedCancellation check guarded by parsed !== value.

dataFlows.name: Terminal Workflow Summary and Metrics Aggregation
dataFlows.path: run.status checked via isTerminalWorkflowStatus -> non-dynamic semanticStatus resolved (completed + run.degradation -> completed_degraded) -> if direct-dynamic and terminal, reads dynamic.controller task output control.json (synthesized, exhausted, blocked, stopped, or completed_without_semantic_result) -> aggregates task.outputRetry?.attempts into outputRetryAttempts and task.launchRetry?.attempts into launchRetries.

unknowns.description: Modules './store.js' and './types.js' are excluded from the repository excerpt per package.json and SPEC.md. Exact implementations of readWorkflowStopIntent, workflowRunPath, workflowRunDir, fromProjectPath, isTerminalWorkflowStatus, finalStageTasks, readJson, and WorkflowRunRecord are unavailable in local files.
unknowns.impact: Downstream lenses must rely on imported signatures, call patterns, and SPEC.md statements rather than inspect store internals.

unknowns.description: Direct execution of git diff/log commands is constrained by the stage tool whitelist (read, grep, find, ls). Inspection is performed on working tree state representing commit 654f639.
unknowns.impact: Code changes between HEAD~1 and HEAD are mapped via working tree surfaces and SPEC.md contracts.

unknowns.description: No unit test files (*.test.ts, *.spec.ts), test fixtures, or test script entries in package.json exist in the repository.
unknowns.impact: Downstream validation stages cannot run automated regression suites; validation is limited to static typechecking and code inspection.

unknowns.description: SPEC.md T3 identifies outputRetryAttempts and launchRetryAttempts as public contracts read by external tools, but external caller codebases are not in this repository.
unknowns.impact: Field renaming or compatibility impact must be assessed against the explicit SPEC.md T3 definition.
